request: Add four more resources to test the current Top 10.

resources_added.name: TrendForce memory-market research
resources_added.scope: Tests whether the consumer-memory story has an underlying supply mechanism. TrendForce reports server capacity prioritization and pressure on PC memory.
limitations: Older industry background, not a same-day event.
Forward-looking price and supply projections are not realized November measurements.
Does not validate attributed interview rhetoric or popularity.

resources_added.name: Arena model and agent evaluations
resources_added.scope: Tests frontier comparisons using platform-specific task and user-session measures. The inspected table places Opus 5.5 above Carbon overall and labels Carbon preliminary.
limitations: Platform population, task mix, settings and uncertainty limit generalization.
Model performance is not topic popularity.
Different metrics and site views show different numbers; no change or growth inferred.
Does not independently reproduce GDPx or business earnings.

resources_added.name: Epoch AI benchmark research
resources_added.scope: Tests the scope of mathematical and comparative capability claims against explicit benchmark methods, version changes and evaluation settings.
limitations: FrontierMath discloses OpenAI funding and exclusive access to a subset; not a wholly independent confirmation of an OpenAI discovery.
The hub mixes internally administered results with external results.
No benchmark run or mathematical proof was independently reproduced here.
Benchmark success does not establish universal research ability or current attention.

resources_added.name: Hacker News community attention
resources_added.scope: Tests whether topics have visible discussion outside video trackers. Finance, mathematics, model-weight experiments, world models and agent testing have retrieved discussion records.
limitations: Technically inclined audience is not representative of all users.
Points/comments are not views and cannot be combined with YouTube counts.
Launch posts can be promotional; comments and pasted emails do not verify technical claims or official policy.
Bounded query sample, not a complete site census.
Specific security thread direct retrieval failed; search index alone provides weak support.

topic_tests.finding: Two inspected finance discussions appear on the community front page; this corroborates discussion, not financial accuracy or rank 1.
Industry research supports memory-capacity competition. Its September date makes it background, not evidence of today's attention.
Mathematical benchmarks provide a narrower test than broad scientific-breakthrough claims; funding and method caveats retained. HN also shows recent mathematics discussion.
A Genie 4 thread displays 1,044 points and 593 comments in the retrieved page. This supports community attention, not a verified simulation-fidelity claim.
A Qwen weight-modification experiment is prominent on the sampled front page. The underlying experiment was not reproduced.
A software-testing agent launch has an active thread; commercial positioning is not evidence of verified business outcomes.
Arena provides an external comparison and uncertainty labels, reinforcing that model rankings depend on tasks and settings.
A retrieved usage-change thread displays 7 points and 5 comments. This is a narrow discussion signal; pasted email wording does not override official documentation.
The bounded search returned a low-engagement agent-security entry through Algolia; direct thread retrieval failed. No new attack claim was verified.
Epoch and Arena provide alternative evaluation methods, not independent replication of GDPx scores.

reason: Additional evidence supports several topic inclusions and exposes limits; it is insufficient to validate or reorder the exact attention ranking.

errors.correction: Inspected the public front page and original discussion pages; used the free Algolia public search endpoint for bounded remaining-topic lookups.

errors.issue: Three Algolia URLs inaccessible through web-open
errors.correction: Public read-only HTTP retrieval succeeded; no metered or paid API used.
Retained limited indexed attention evidence, with no verified incident claim.
Genie thread page showed 593 comments while Algolia showed 594; source observations were not merged and no growth inferred.

limits: No global popularity order or measured momentum established.
Historical video observation times and research generation time remain unchanged.
This validation extension is not a new full video review or Compiler run.
